params.body:
The second line behind the pipeline for the competitor list of Standard 0.17.0 (gentells-standard #22, pipeline #381): nothing that names or links a listed competitor is written to gentells.com, even if it gets past the pipeline.

**Pin v0.17.0.** The site was on v0.8.0. `bin/sync-standard.mjs` now also copies `rules/competitors.json` into `resources/standard/standard.json`, and writes the Standard's competitor cases to `tests/fixtures/standard-competitors.json`.

**`App\Standard\Competitors`**, a port of the Standard's `competitorsIn` / `competitorOfLink`. `CompetitorsTest` runs the Standard's 30 conformance cases against it, so site and pipeline agree on "a zine for teens" (no hit), "the Edelman Trust Barometer" (no hit) and `insights.ypulse.com` (YPulse).

**The tagging gate reads what an item says.** `TaggingGate::check($kind, $tags, $text = [])`: a field that names a competitor is a problem, so the item is held with a `tagging_records` row explaining it ("body: names WGSN, a competitor Gentells does not name"), like any other hold.
- Posts: title, dek, body and the Opportunity.
- Trends: headline, summary and the reading fields.
- `gentells:tagging-audit` passes the same text, so a dry run lists what is already published and names one.

**Links are dropped, not held.** A post's evidence row, or a signal under a trend, that links to or names a competitor is left out when the projection writes it. One stray citation does not take a whole post down; the pipeline already refuses it at the source.

**What else the jump from 0.8.0 to 0.17.0 changes in the gate:**
- Gen Beta is no longer reserved (0.13.0). It is tagged only beside Young Families (`onlyWith`), and Millennials only beside Gen Z, Gen Alpha or Young Families. The gate now holds a context generation that stands alone, as the Standard's validator refuses it, so the site is not looser than the Standard. Tests updated: "reserved" becomes "stands only beside".
- `gen-millennials` resolves to a live term again.
- Elements: 0.17.0 adds a 0.3 floor for new data but keeps `weight.above`, which is what the gate checks, so older posts with lower weights still pass, as the Standard intends.

Tests: 481 of 482; `BuildStampTest` fails in a worktree as always. Pint clean.

**After deploy (Forge):** `php artisan gentells:tagging-audit` is a dry run and shows what 0.17.0 would correct or hold among what is live, the competitor hits included; `--apply` only after reading it. The next reconcile holds a trend that names a competitor; the delete brake still refuses a run that would take more than half off.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: Pin Standard v0.17.0; the gate holds a text that names a competitor
